fixed.summary: A game whose start calls og.load.font on a face of its locale's font pack (Night Shift's HUD font, fonts/latin/NotoSans-Latin.ttf) starts on the web. The web fetches pack faces after the boot, so start threw that the font was still being fetched and the game never drew; start now waits at the tick boundary until the locale's faces have landed, as it waits for the boot scene.

No tick runs, and no game time accrues, before GameDesc.start has run: while start waits for the boot scene or the locale's font faces, a frame or a probe advance runs no systems. Before, ticks could run on the half-built world while the boot scene loaded, and a system reading what start makes threw. Tick 0 is still the first tick after start, so replays and the probe's ticks are unchanged.
